reviews.title: Fantastic in all aspects.
reviews.text: Great location, shuttle to strip, clean, very nice condo and entire facility. Pool and pool bar very nice. Staff friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Our stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed every one we encountered during check in & checking out. Even just inquiring best options to go here or there the staff was very reliable & helpful.

reviews.title: Dessert Blue
reviews.text: Great view, clean room and friendly staff. I'd recommend to anyone visiting Las Vegas. We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Good Choice off the Strip
reviews.text: We stayed seven days at the Wyndham. Our room was spacious, clean, and the bed was very comfortable. The small kitchen was well equipped with a toaster, microwave, fridge, and coffee maker.Check-in was easy, and the staff member who helped us was friendly and professional. However, after checking in, we were directed to the Member Desk to pick up our wristbands, where we were immediately pressured to sign up for a timeshare presentation — something I didn’t appreciate after a long flight.We were never informed that there would be a fee if we wanted our room cleaned, though they did bring fresh towels upon request.The resort is within walking distance of the Strip, and there’s also a convenient shuttle to Treasure Island, or you can easily take an Uber. Overall, it was a good experience — quieter than staying directly on the Strip, with plenty of free parking available.

reviews.title: Uncomfortable with sales pitch
reviews.text: Check in was a pain, first desk was check in and needed a $250 security deposit, then sent me to a second desk to get the room key, this was a sales desk that claimed we must attend a sales presentation and wanted more money to confirm the appointment. I refused to pay but still got pushed into the presentation. I did attend for a free lunch.  So we spent the night, the room was nice, clean, but the furniture was very uncomfortable, If you failed to get clean in the shower the towels would sand the dirt and you skin right off.  The next morning, the sales pitch. Super high pressure even though I told them they were wasting their time.  They just got more aggressive and really did not like when I would call out the lies. They call this a resort, well.... Yes there is a pool and hot tub, with bar and grill, however the grill was only open a couple hours a day. No restaurant, they didn't have coffee until 9am afternoon drinks at 3pm for maybe an hour. No restaurants within a reasonable walking distance. Yes they had a shuttle to get to Treasure Island on the strip, that was the best part but even that didn't start until 9am. Overall just a poor excuse for a hotel.

reviews.title: FILTHY carpet, horrible rude staff
reviews.text: FILTHY carpet, horrible rude staff, two guys at the front desk were the worstnever stay againWyndham Diamond treated worse

reviews.title: Unfortunately would not recommend
reviews.text: Certainly not a 4 star resort. I was reading other reviews and was extremely hopeful. Stayed as part of the timeshare preview program. Needed a room with two beds, but was only able to book a one bedroom due to availability. When I arrived, they said you can only upgrade to a two bedroom if youre an “owner”. So I got stuck on the sofa bed. It was very dirty and in extremely bad shape, the most uncomfortable sofa bed I’ve ever had the displeasure of sleeping on. I was inspecting for bugs and found a tiny brown, jumping thing on the mattress. The next morning, I let the front desk know about the state of the bed and they sent up a “tech” with a wash rag and a spray bottle. I sent them away. The room was fine otherwise, although the bathroom smelled faintly of urine. Did not use any of the amenities/facilities but the store was well stocked. We quietly left after one night to the Mandalay Bay where the experience was much better.

reviews.title: Clean but needs a few restaurants
reviews.text: With no restaurants at the resort, aside from the luncheon cantina, it made it difficult to arrange for lunch and evening meals since we normally do not get a rental car on vacation. The pool and pool area were lovely and well maintained. Also when asking the consierrege service for recommendations and/or discounts to local eateries, after the first day-they were none.

reviews.title: Trip to Vegas_2025
reviews.text: Nice room and peopleOnly thing I don't like is The RCI staff asked me to provide a deposit for a face to face talk appointment.

reviews.title: One of this company's best properties
reviews.text: My third visit to Las Vegas. First time at Desert Blue. After a hectic week at Panama City Beach earlier this year, we returned to the sort of accommodation we expect from this company. Clean, spacious & well looked after. After a polite and efficient check in we spoke to the concierge desk who got us a great deal on dining and discounted attraction tickets. We also got a list of discounted show ticket which we did use later in the week, really pleased with that. We stayed in a Margaritaville room which had the whirlpool bath and smoothie cocktail maker, everything fine. The property has a 24 hour shop for drinks, snacks and essentials which was well stocked, not too expensive and had a discount for VIP guests. There was a free coffee cart with good coffee of different types, including iced, at 8 am  weekends 9am other days. WE had activities in the foyer including tequila and bourbon tasting. The pool area was spacious and well staffed with free towels. The high light for me was the pool area bar and café.  Prices much lower the the strip, good beer and cocktails, daily specials and offers (2 for 1 etc.). The guys running this bar need a mention for their warm hospitality and humour, they were a pleasure to deal with, VIP discount also extended to drinks and food. Their burger was as good as anything you'll find on the strip and half the price. There was a free shuttle bus each hour to Treasure Island resort which ran quite late at weekends. The drivers were super helpful with tips and directions to attraction on the strip. We also used uber drivers and never waited more than 8 minutes for a pick up. I look forward to staying again one day.

reviews.title: Can't wait too. go back!!!
reviews.text: Clean, lots of activities. Went to see Bruno Mars. The pool area was fantastic. Game room, gym, fresh coffee every morning. Just an all and all wonderful time! We will definitely return!!!

reviews.title: AvoidThis Place
reviews.text: Generally a nice property. Great pool area. Rooms are mini-condos, so they have a full or partial kitchen convenient for families or being able to avoid expensive Vegas dining. The downside was that I booked through the Wyndham Hotels Rewards App, but when I arrived,  they could not find my reservation (apparently the property is "licenced" to both Wyndham  and Hilton Vacation Clubs - a timeshare). After nearly an hour, we finally got a room in the nearly full place. When you get your room, you go to "Resort Services" to get information and a wrist band that allows room access and amenities entrance. The "Service" turns out my to be a hard sell Timeshare pitch and we finally had to tell to gentleman that we were tired after a busy day and were no interested in timeshares at all. When I asked at the front desk about getting my Wyndham  reward points, I was told to save my receipt and contact Wyhdham Hotels. I contacted the Hotels division and was told to contact the property. No way to win and my last stay at a Wyndham property. They seem more interested in timeshares sales than customer service.

reviews.title: Great hotel, but comes with a time share hard sell. Buyer be ware
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, but not on the Vegas Strip.Big rooms with kitchen, very clean well appointed.Great pool area.Good shuttle bus into the strip very hour.Now for the con :( Beware of the hard sell as the Wydnam group of hotels is a "time share" and the marketing company is hard core sell.

reviews.title: Amazing. Pick this hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel was spotless, fab pool area with an actual hot tub! The room we had was perfect - huge 2 bedroom apartment. Staff were friendly and the smoothies at the bar were great! Cannot fault the place at all, it was lovely and quiet too. Thank you!!

reviews.title: Great Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: Club Wyndham Desert Blue was a great family resort at a great location in Vegas.  We loved the pool and bbq areas.  The staff was very friendly.  The shuttle service was reliable and dropped us off at a great spot on the Vegas strip.

reviews.title: Worst Club wyndham avoid at all cost!!!!
reviews.text: Avoid @ all costs.Stay somewhere else. Bad rooms, worst sale mongers and terrible atmosphere fullnof sick and nasty children.

reviews.title: Hotel oversold
reviews.text: They're criminals. With a reservation confirmed by expedition I was denied the room because it was oversold and sent as compensation to a hotel of the lower category and worse located chain... the desert rose... a shame... and refused to give it to me in writing to claim expedition so I had to make the claim based on a video recorded by the Representative of the hotel...

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: Highly Recommend. Our room was very clean. Spacious. Kitchen was well equipped. Pool was big and clean. Shuttle was a great service. Runs on the hour every hour to the strip Treasure Island and pick up is on the half. Very convenient. Hotel provided self parking and valet parking both free. There was a pool table and other things for kids. The shuttle also takes you and brings you back from the supermarket daily. We stayed on the strip and here during the same trip and would stay at Wyndham instead of the strip. Easier access. Less traffic. More space.

reviews.title: 2nd Stay as Good as the First
reviews.text: This was our second year staying at Desert Blue during the July 4th-11th week. We love everything about it. The staff especially goes out of their way to make it a wonderful experience. Check in is a breeze, I needed more coffee for the coffee maker and it was delivered to me within 10 minutes. The pool help is attentive, the Poolside Grill has good food, good drinks and good staff. Elevators work flawlessly. Everything in our 1 bedroom worked perfectly. Love the view of the Rio and the city at night. bed and pillows are comfy, air works excellent. Wrist fobs to enter every door worked great. The shuttle to grocery store is really nice as well as to and from the Treasure Island on strip.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay, the shuttle to the strip was great and the activities were so much fun.  Really enjoyed the pool.

reviews.title: My Stay at This Hotel
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and helpful. I have stayed at this hotel last year and I will continue to due so in the coming years. Outstanding place and the staff was wonderful. I would recommend this facility to all individuals who would traveling to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Harassment at Resort
reviews.text: I was bombarded by very aggressive marketers who called me incessantly in my room and insisted I had to come down to the lobby to get a wristband that very day I checked in! I complained to the front desk and while they were apologetic they said it was a different team and they had no control over them. Then the manager of the marketing team called me because I complained and was a total ass to me. It was pure harassment, I wanted this experience to be replaced by RCI but was refused.

reviews.title: Wonderful Las Vegas accomodation.
reviews.text: Excellent stay, probably one of the best resorts we have stayed at, great room, great staff and fantastic pool area, all close to the strip. Excellent shuttle service.

reviews.title: Customer unfriendly
reviews.text: Hotel was so far ok, room great. Pool landscape also nice, but.... Very loud music all day. I was always alone at the three pools until about 13.00. When I asked the people at the pool to turn down the music a little, I couldn't. I was not allowed to lie on the air mattress, forbidden. Even if no one else was there. Terrible! The $250 deposit hasn't been paid back to us for 3 weeks, although we sent a video saying room was left fine.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The resort was even nicer than the reviews that I read. The outdoor swimming pools and hot tubs were amazing. The staff was helpful and there is a shuttle to take you over to the strip and drop you off in front of Treasure Island. The rooms are spacious & stocked with everything we needed. They also provided free valet parking! This was a great place to stay & we will definitely be returning.

reviews.title: While in Vegas for a work event
reviews.text: I booked a room with my timeshare exchange into Club Wyndham Dessert Blue in May 2025.  I was pleasantly suprised by the large, clean rooms and friendly staff.  A huge bonus was ample parking near our building and the great Billiard and foozball game room.  We enjoyed our stay and appreciated the comfortable beds.

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of staying at this beautiful property. It was clean, fresh and updated. Room was spacious, clean and updated.  Comfy bed.The location was perfect. Not on the strip but just a few min away in the shuttle. No casino on the property which was a plus because that equals no smoke. Pools, hot tubs and food at the pool bar was good. Staff was very welcoming and pleasant to deal with the entire time. They had scheduled events everyday. We really enjoyed the morning coffee and one afternoon was a bourbon tasting. I have nothing but good things to say about Desert Blue. We will be back for our next Vegas stay!

reviews.title: Wyndham Blue Desert Resort
reviews.text: Resort was very nice, large pool with splash pad, great for family’s, also restaurant near pool, super convenient! Loved the shuttle that runs every hour, every morning also to grocery store, able to stock room for the week with snacks and food for a couple of dinners in room. Kitchens are stocked very well for everything you need to cook and have meals in room. Small store on site, very well stocked. Would definitely return to this resort!!

reviews.title: Beautifully designed property
reviews.text: Had a wonderful relaxing time. Kid friendly. Well maintained. Courteous staff in all aspects. Great safety features. Would definitely visit again.

reviews.title: As a bonus
reviews.text: Second stay.. world class hotel without the pomp of " luxury " on-site salespitch is mildly annoying,  but a small piece of the puzzle..I got a suite and it's a 3 room work of hyper clean art.  Free shuttle to T.I. so,  you can do feel like you are on the strip without the crazy crowds.. nice little convenience store as a bonus

reviews.title: best Wyndham ever
reviews.text: "Clean and organized". pool was very clean and "cold" family friendly - unique when it comes to social activities, everyday there was an activity to socialize with other members and everything was free. shuttle bus on time and friendly. My room looked like new.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great location just off the strip. Shuttle was nice and always on time. Nice room!  We would certainly consider staying there again.

reviews.title: Top Notch Accomodations in a Perfect Location
reviews.text: The Desert Blue is a great property and super well maintained.  I got a two-bedroom presidential suite on the 16th floor and the space and views were spectacular!  This was the second time I stayed in the same floor-plan and will always opt for the extra space.  The staff were excellent and always helpful!

reviews.title: Guys Trip
reviews.text: Great location. Clean and big room. Complimentary shuttle to and from strip. Friendly staff. Resort was great for what we were there for. 2 pools and 2 hot tubs. Highly recommend. Would stay there again.

reviews.title: Sour on Desert Blue
reviews.text: I loved this resort I'd visit at least 2 times a year. The bartender Constantine and his island crew are wonderful. I bought there about 6 yrs ago. I was so sad leaving this last time due to the house keeping supervisor. Back story I asked if we could have an extra hour to check out time prior to arriving. At 8:30 am the supervisor opened our door and entered screaming time to wake up and get going at the top of his lungs. I am surprised my son didn't get physical as he was on the way to the bathroom. I don't think I will ever return sadly. One man or policy ruined our vacation!

reviews.title: Nice facility off the strip
reviews.text: Facility is amazing.  Only down is that there is no gabling onsite, though super close the strip.  We also rented a VRBO/not direct.  I wouldn't do that again.  Not only did they change our dates 2 weeks prior to arrival forcing us to find 1 night stays for 4 colleagues...not an easy task for the busiest convention week of the year in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Very clean.  Quick check in. Large room. All utensils and plates you would need. Washer, dryer, ironing board, etc.  Security safe.Excellent shuttle service to LV strip - runs until after midnight on weekends

reviews.title: Superbowl watching party at Las Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed in Desert Blue for 5 nights around Superbowl weekend. It is near China Town with access to many Asian restaurants. The hotel staff were very friendly and pool area was clean with heated pools and great Jacuzi.  Wifi in room and common area were excellent and I was able to work remotely from the hotel.

reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised when we arrived.  Everything exceeded my expectations.  Staff was great.  Free valet.  Room was excellent.  Everything was top notch.  Beds were very comfortable.  Great view from out room.  Too cold to use the pools, but looked nice.  Hot tub  was nice.  Don't go to the time share review.  Like most reviews they are very friendly and then the HARD sell.  Our gifts were to a low budget show and $100 worth of food certificates.  We had a hard time using the certificates and finally found we could use them at Caesar's food court, not a buffet.  On top of that we had to pay $35 to park at Caesars.  Self parking at all the other casinos was $20-25.  Save money on parking by getting a MGM rewards card.  With that card you can park free a MGM  affiliate casinos:  Excalibur, Bellagio, Arial and a few others.  Check with the Rewards staff on how to use the reward's card and what casinos except them.  Best part of the visit was going to the SPHERE.    Ticket prices vary on where you buy them. Best price we found was at Spotlight.Vegas.  Use your GPS, Lots of construction and bumper to bumper traffic.

reviews.title: Run don’t walk away from this Club Wyndham Vacation club!
reviews.text: I purchased a Club Wyndham Wyndham vacation club. It is a total rip off and overcharge you by so much money. Do your research through other third-party sites before you book or sign up for this vacation club. It would have been much less if I booked through Tripadvisor, but being a member, I thought I was getting special treatment and prices. Turns out I was being charged quadruple. I went out of this contract and do not sign up for this. They take advantage of people and it is inhumane. Leave now do not sign up.

reviews.title: Blue oasis in the center of Las Vegas
reviews.text: If you don’t want casino noise and crowds, just a nice and quiet hotel, the Wyndham Blue Desert is a great option. The suites are spacious and clean. Staff is friendly and helpful. The facilities include a large resort pool area and spa, gym, rec room and office space. To get you to the strip is a five-minute shuttle ride (on the hour) or return (on the half hour), or a 15 minutes walk. There’s no indoor restaurant or breakfast area, but a breakfast place within walking distance.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: Well kept with everything you could need including washer and dryer.  Clean room and facilities.  Friendly and helpful staff. Shuttle to Treasure Island.  There is an excellent breakfast place 1 block away.   Hopefully renovation of the Rio will make it even better

reviews.title: A good place to stay off the strip.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Desert Blue. We had a one bedroom with full kitchen which came in handy as there is no restaurant. We had a car rented so we bought some groceries.There were plenty of parking spots for the car and there is also a shuttle to Treasure Island the leaves on the hour and it worked well.  The staff are nice and the hotel is clean and quiet. The amenities at the pool area also looked clean and well maintained. There is a snack bar at the pool but its a hit and miss on the hours they are open.This hotel is a time share so be prepared for the sales pitch to attend a presentation.Liked the Desert Blue.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This is one of the best hotels for a great price.  I think I found my hotel for every time I visit Las Vegas.  The staff is friendly, the rooms are grand, and the service is impeccable!  I really hope that they keep fhe same management.  They saved my trip!

reviews.title: Modern Resort
reviews.text: The Wyndham Desert Blue is a good place to stay near the Las Vegas strip. The walk is less than one mile to Las Vegas Boulevard. You have free parking here and a heated outdoor pool. Rent a car a drive to other places of interest. There is no onsite restaurant. Walk across the street to the Rio Casino for for, entertainment and gambling.

reviews.title: Very Nice!!!
reviews.text: Highly recommend staying there!   Everything was perfect!  Not located on the strip but the shuttle got us there in no time at all.  We had a wonderful time.  Staff was great along with first class accommodations.  You can't go wrong with this resort.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We had a great time! Loved the activities at the resort and it's amenities! We will be back in the future! Shout out to Adrian at the front desk for working with us!

reviews.title: Friendly service and large clean rooms
reviews.text: We stayed in a Standard Studio booked via Expedia. Check-in was fast and friendly, strangely as part of the check-in process we got sent to another desk where they tried to sell us a timeshare but they weren't too pushy and accepted "No thank you" before giving us the room wrist bands and letting us go.The room was very spacious, clean and had all the amenities we needed for our short stay, fridge, dishwasher, microwave etc.Both the king size bed and to our surprise even to sofa bed was super comfortable. The sofa bed didn't even feel like a sofa bed.We didn't use the pool. But I did use the gym, really well-equipped and I had the place all to myself. There was a small shop downstairs next to the lobby and a recreational room but we didn't use them.The hotel is obviously not on the strip, but it's only a $10 + tip uber ride away.We would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Awesome Resort
reviews.text: This place is fantastic! Large clean suite well appointed. Parking is good. No resort fee and a superb pool

reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.text: Very comfortable.  Great amenities.  Easy access to the Strip. Very courteous staff.Plenty of activities. Wish there was a shuttle to airport. Need USB outlets throughout rooms. Loved the wristband to enter room and facilities. Very quiet.

reviews.title: Avoid this place - they don't want you as a hotel guest
reviews.text: I had set up a reservation here a month before I arrived via the Wyndham awards site, had a confirmation and reservation number and such.  Pulling in after a somewhat grueling day traveling, I was curtly told they had no record of me.  I showed them my citation in my Wyndham account.  I showed them the email I received.I was told that there was "another" email--email specifically--I should have received, and without that "other" email there was "nothing we can do for you".  I mean, suppose that was true--that they needed some kind of "other" email (which I guess would preclude anybody who had accidentally deleted it, or didn't have internet, or whatever), or the system had just lost the reservation on their end.  The place wasn't full by a longshot, don't you think they'd just set up another room and set me up with it?Nope.  Can't help you.  Threw me out into the humid night.Reading other reviews and talking with cab drivers over the rest of my trip, I can only assume the deal is:  they are looking to make this place all time shares.  They took one look at me dressed for my three-day professional nerd conference and decided I wasn't going to be able to be turned as a timeshare buyer.  That's the only thing that makes sense.Wyndham acquired my beloved La Quinta Inns franchise, and that's the only reason I'm with them as a Wyndham Awards member.  I'll continue to go to La Quinta, b/c they're by and large awesome, but I am going to be very wary of Wyndham branded hotels in the future.

reviews.title: GREAT GIRLS TRIP
reviews.text: We went to Vegas on a girls trip and the Wyndham Desert Blue was great. The staff was cheerful and friendly. Check in was a breeze. The 2 bedroom condo was perfect.The coffee in the morning and cocktails in the afternoon was great. But get there early as they do run out. The pool was VERY nice. 2 different pools and a kiddy area. Also life guards at one on them. The shuttle is nice but it does stop at 9:30 during the week and 1:30am on weekends. But we just Ubered back. That can get quite expensive as the resort is off the strip. The shuttle to the grocery store was also nice. We stocked up on a few things for the room and ate in a few times. It had everything we needed. We did do the timeshare presentation. They were aware of the fact that we were not interested but the $150 in Uber credits that we chose came in quite handy. And it was quite painless. The RIO and Gold Coast is walking distance but would not do it at night alone. You have to walk through a parking lot and it is very empty. The only downfall was the distance to the strip. Otherwise, it was a GREAT trip!

reviews.title: Amazing hotel, staff ..  all in all excellent stay
reviews.text: Everything was amazing! The service, the hotel vibe, extremely comfortable bed, beautiful and relaxing pool area, happy coffee hour in the morning , happy hour in the lobby at 3.30pm ☺️ and the staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive making our stay truly memorable ( and special mention goes to Eric on the front desk/valet - you are a true asset to the company). If you are looking for a quiet relaxing place to stay, away from the busy strip, but in the walking distance 10 -  15 min walk to the Caesar’ (, we have not used their shuttle service, so cannot comment as we enjoyed walking, ) so this place is for you! Recommend! We will be back to this hotel 100%!  Thank you! 🤩

reviews.title: Fab hotel just off the strip
reviews.text: My mum and I were visiting for 5 nights after touring the westcoast from the UK. We wanted a hotel that had a relaxed vibe after a busy day exploring, our holiday had been hectic and we were planning some nice down time. This hotel was perfect, we had a studio double queen and it was really big and some of the comfiest beds and pillows I’ve ever come across. The staff were fab, the pool area was pretty and chilled, pool just a tad cold, but didn’t stop us going in, it was red hot. The only downside and need for improvement is the hotel shuttle, so I know it’s supposed to go on the hour or half hour but it’s not enough and sometimes there’s not enough room for people. It’s only over the road so it would be good if they put on the shuttle every 15 mins especially during busier periods. I’d recommend this hotel to anyone, exceeded our expectations

reviews.title: No late dinner
reviews.text: Good hotel the parking guys are great do a good job get you car to you in a quick fashion easy to find with the construction the only bad thing the grill at the bar closing hours are 9 pm but every time i when to at 6 pm it was  closed ate there on night and the stuff we trade to order was out.

reviews.title: September at Desert Blue
reviews.text: Great place to stay but an mess up when booking. Asked for 7 days and was told they only had 5 so we took that rather than not going.  Upon arrival we were charger a $167 cleaning fee and told it was because we were only staying 5 days not 7. We explained that we wanted 7 and were told we couldn't get it. Check in staff said they didn't know why that would be as the had that room available for 7. We are not happy and hopefully we will be given a credit.

reviews.title: 5 star experience, 3 star price
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for our anniversary, and wow, I liked everything about the place.   The rooms were large and luxurious, the staff was exceptionally friendly, and everything was immaculately clean.  If you don't like waking up in the morning in your $500/night hotel, only to have to go downstairs and wait in line for 30 minutes to get a cup of coffee, you might want to try the Wyndham Desert Blue.  Coffee and a coffee maker are provided, along with a good sized refrigerator to store drinks.  The room comes with a nice kitchenette with microwave, dishes and silverware- basically all the things that you need for a comfortable stay  but are usually lacking in "high-end" hotels. The strip is only a mile or two away and the Mercedes van shuttle has convenient hourly runs. The drop off point at Treasure Island is literally only a 5 minute walk to the world class restaurant row in the Venetian.  The buzz and nightlife of the strip is easily accessible, but it's nice to come back and sleep in a quiet hotel with some amenities that are greatly appreciated.  I've probably stayed in 75% of the strip hotels, but the Wyndham Desert Blue is my new favorite place to stay.  It's a 5 star experience.  If you book a stay, walk down Twain street a couple of blocks and try LIttle Italy's pizzeria.  It's frequented by locals, and it's fantastic. If you like to gamble, and you like the best odds, try the Gold Coast casino, also only fifteen minute walk  away.

reviews.title: Delighted
reviews.text: From the valet , the bellmen, the friendly check in, the room appointments to the fresh and clean pool area and then the snack bar at the pool, we really had a wonderful stay. We have children and grandchildren who live close and they joined us at the pool and were very comfortable there. Our stay was delightful!

reviews.title: wonderful experience.
reviews.text: It feels like home. Everyone is very welcoming and there is a shuttle bus to the main road every day, which is very convenient. There's no casino downstairs. It's quiet.

reviews.title: Vegas Business Trip
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful and well maintained.  Valet staff was always very helpful.  Shuttle to grocery store and Treasure Island was very convenient.  Rooms are spacious and clean.  Views from the room were beautiful.  Pool area had plenty of seating in both the sun and shade.  Peaceful with easy access to the strip.  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great 1BR Suite!
reviews.text: Great view with a large workspace. Would book again! Food selection at hotel is sparce but there is Polaris Cafe down the street with a great breakfast!

reviews.title: Best resort so far
reviews.text: Staff members were respectful, kind prompt to help whenever possible.I accidentally broke the microwave plate. I notified the front desk and asked for a bandage. A young man brought a new plate with the bandage and was concerned about my injury. I convinced him that I was fine, My husband and I were treated like family.

reviews.title: A++++ Highly recommend!
reviews.text: Such a pleasant experience! Staff super friendly and helpful. Room very clean and well appointed. No housekeeping service unless you pay extra but easy to dispose of garbage and get fresh linens and there’s a broom and carpet sweeper in the room. Kitchenette well stocked with dishes, silverware, glassware, etc plus a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher detergent, and paper towels. Free valet and self parking. Shuttle to/from Treasure Island and local grocery store is a huge plus. We had minor issues during our stay - mini fridge and AC stopped working - but AC repaired and fridge replaced very quickly by friendly & professional staff. Pool area very clean, plenty of loungers, and lots of shaded areas. Ping pong and tons of lawn games available for guest use. Food at pool bar very reasonably priced and tasty. There is a small store onsite but it’s super overpriced. Other amenities include computer room, work out room, daily coffee bar, social hour in the lobby, and daily craft activities for kids and adults.

reviews.title: Pushy Sales Pitch
reviews.text: First off, if you are a time share owner here, the Poor rating review is not for you.  The pools are clean, beautiful and not over-crowded.  The 9:30 am coffee hour and the 3:30 pm drink hour are nice.  A complaint I have related to the pool is that the small smoking area for the hotel is nearby so we were often getting whiffs of cigarette and marijuana smoke.  Our room was roomy and nice.  The only complaint was that the dishwasher wasn't working properly.  The reason I give the hotel a Poor Rating is the time share sales push.  Our family arrived later in the evening and we were all anxious to settle in, get a bite to eat and go to sleep.  Once I checked in, I was sent over to a different desk to get my access wristbands.  I won't mention the guy's name, but despite my constant "I'm not interested." and "I am tired and want to go to my room." he wouldn't give up on the sales pitch.  I almost felt like I was being harassed.  It was so upsetting that it spoiled my hotel stay.  I purposely avoided the lobby area and turned down the 3:30 pm drink hour once because he was in the area.  Obviously, we won't be back and when I book any future hotel stays, I will steer clear of time share hotels.

reviews.title: Nice condo
reviews.text: This is a nice condo close to the strip.  The pull out sofa has a 5” mattress so sleeping on it isn’t painful.  The staff was quick to respond to a minor maintenance issue.  Free valet.

reviews.title: Lovely pool area, with space, sun loungers and shade
reviews.text: Great for families wanting a slightly less crazy Vegas experience. We booked off strip to hopefully get some things we didn’t feel we would get on any of the hotels on the strip: a big fridge, free parking, sun loungers and shade!  We got all 4 and the pool area is even nicer than the pictures, with plenty of space, sun loungers and shade without any charges.Valet parking is free which is rare in the US.  The hotel itself is underwhelming but perfectly clean and has a kitchen in the studios and enough room to move around. Free shuttle bus to and from the strip and the grocery store so a really good base if you want to spend some time by the pools and chill in the day.

reviews.title: Shuttle friendly
reviews.text: Shuttle to the strip is a bonus, location is spotless, staff is friendly.. the only down is they need some sorry if good options other than the in house store supplies... But that's ok..Shuttle to the strip on the hour, to the grocery store once a day I think..Drink meet and greet daily

reviews.title: Club Wyndham Desert Blue
reviews.text: Excellent stay with top notch amenities and a clean facility at a great location in Las Vegas. We would return in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Best Resort Stay Ever
reviews.text: Nothing but 5 stars for our experience. The check in was easy, room was terrfic. 1 Bdrm deluxe worked perfectly for 3 of us. The view is great from all rooms. We had a nightly view of the Rio Hotel Building light show! Shuttle service was adequate. We could walk to the Rio, Gold Coast and The Palms. A nice neighborhood of casinos! Morning coffee and afternoon toddys were nice. 2 pools and splash pad, excellent, as well as the pool cafe and bar. We did rent a car and drove to the Valley of Fire on one of the days. I highly recommend making that 1 hour dive and plan for 2-4 hours there. It was 119 degrees the day we went and it was tolerable. I have nothing but good things to say about the booking process, staff, and amenities for the desert Blue Resort. Will for sure stay there again.

reviews.title: Wonderful Place!
reviews.text: From the time we were greeted, till the moment we left, the staff was absolutely amazing!  They were kind and truly cared about how our stay was going.  The valet drivers were prompt and extremely nice and prompt.  The messaging system they have to retrieve your vehicle was perfect.  We were never sitting around waiting for our vehicle.  They also offered daily runs with a shuttle to get groceries or take you to and from the strip.  The pools were clean, rooms were clean.  Everything was up to date.  Would definitely recommend staying at this resort!  Thank you for an amazing time!

reviews.title: A BEAUTIFUL CONDO CLOSE TO THE LAS VEGAS STRIP
reviews.text: This ia a very nice condo.  Our view from the 12th floor was really nice.  The pool and spas were great.  There is a free shuttle from the condo to Treasure Island that runs back and forth.  The staff were all very friendly.  The only downside was that there was no hand soap, body wash, or shampoo in the bottles that were in the bathrooms.  Housekeeping did bring some for the main bathroom.. They were locked in place.  I called to let them know they did not bring these items for the second bathroom, and nobody ever came and brought them.

reviews.title: Worst resort hotel I've ever visited.
reviews.text: This has been the worst resort of its kind I've ever stayed at, as a member owner who just bought the Wyndham membership and making use of my benefits of stay that 100% let down, the room completely unacceptable, the sofa bed could not be extended completely so sleeping there was impossible, dirty furniture, gnawed table, the mattress broken, dirty and with mold-like stains, the closet door broken, terrible front desk service, and they did not want to make much effort to change rooms. Coming down with photos and videos of the room was when they decided to do something to change us. The new room, we got three half, and in the bathroom there was no liquid soap, I ordered at least 4 times and it was not until the third day that we were given soap. Upon registering we were told he was Wyndham Presidential and the “newest” in town. But believe me I would never stay there and I will not recommend it. My stay was from 18 to 22 May

reviews.title: Great beds!
reviews.text: The rooms are equipped with great mattresses and pillows. We are even considering getting these items for home.The pool area is nice and clean. The food and drink at the pool bar is delicious and also quite cheap.The service is very friendly and the hotel offers a free Vegas Strip shuttle that runs every hour. There is a small self-service supermarket in the hotel.After checking out, you can use the pool area for longer and your luggage will be stored.There are showers and changing rooms in the pool area so you can freshen up before you leave.

reviews.title: lovely hotel.
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. had free coffee hr every day, sometimes with goodies, free social in the lobby every day with free drinks. Cara and Bree are the nicest folks, say .hi for us!Enjoyed riding the bus to grocery store when needed, and to the strip at convenient times. nice drivers, always helpful and courteous. you really cant go wrong with this convenient hotel, located away from the hustle and bustle but just a few minutes free bus ride.

reviews.title: Quiet Las Vegas Resort close to The Strip
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort.  The staff were friendly and helpful and the complimentary valet service so convenient.  The pool/spa area is just beautiful and quiet. Great location with restaurants and shopping close.  I would love to come back here in the future.

reviews.title: Desert Blue is an OUTSTANDING resort hotel!!!
reviews.text: Desert Blue is our favorite hotel that we've stayed in out of all of the Wyndham Vacation Club hotels.  The service and accommodations are top notch.  The hotel interior and exterior and pool area are gorgeous, and the management, front desk staff, lifeguards, grill and bar staff are so helpful and friendly.  The valet parking is a welcome bonus.  My wife and I were there to watch our two granddaughters while there parents were conducting business.  We highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.title: Best Vegas Stay Ever !
reviews.text: The size of this condo was Awesome, we were on the 7th floor and location was perfect ! Free Valet, little store in lobby, beautiful accommodations, pool and hot tubs on site Grill/bar at pool side with cabanas ! Extra sink/counter located across from the tub, step in shower and bath was large !  They have a shuttle service but we didn't use since we had a rental car !

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel 10/15 minutes from the strip
reviews.text: We recommend this hotel close to the strip, just 10/15 minutes walk from the strip or 5 minutes via the free hotel shuttle.Very well equipped, with a beautiful and large kitchen allowing you to eat in the room. Bathroom with shower and bathtub and equipped with a washing machine and dryer. Go there with your eyes closed

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: Such a clean, peaceful and tasteful hotel. The staff are friendly.Loved it here. And the pool area is beautiful - with a splash pad for kids!!The location is close to the strip (there's a free shuttle to Treasure Island).This hotel does not have a casino and is VERY family friendly.

reviews.title: Manipulative staff
reviews.text: Nice place, however we were mislead into a timeshare presentation under the pretense of tour for the purpose of advertising rather than a sales pitch. During which they were incredibly pushy to sell you a package with no actual details on the price or what you are getting and will use every trick in the book to try convince you. Not even worth the free stuff they offer for your time.

reviews.title: Off strip but across from Rio so best of both worlds plus free shuttle. Perfect place for couples getaway.
reviews.text: Off strip but across from Rio so best of both worlds plus free shuttle. Perfect place for couples getaway.

reviews.title: Very good choice!
reviews.text: We stayed 4 nights at Club Wyndham Desert Blue and loved it. All staff members are smiling and welcoming. We had a studio with a small kitchen counter including a fridge, a dishwasher, a coffee maker and a toaster which would help with a few meals. Comfortable bedding. The pool is great. A shuttle leaves every hour to Treasure Island and returns to the hotel every 30 minutes. The shuttle also goes to the supermarket at 10 a.m. which is practical when you don't have a car. The journey to Treasure Island takes approximately 15 minutes on foot. I recommend this hotel without hesitation.

reviews.title: Beautiful, clean resort close to the strip.
reviews.text: Stayed at the Desert Blue on a recent 5 day girls trip getaway in a 2 Bedroom Deluxe unit. The unit was clean, spacious, and extremely comfortable. The entire resort is well maintained, the staff is lovely, and the pool area is great. There is a lovely pool bar with drinks and food. Vegetarian options available which was a real treat for me! Wish the pool and hot tub hours were a little later than 9pm because I do think a soak in the hot tub coming back from late shows would have been amazing. There is a free shuttle that drops off on the hour to Treasure Island and picks up on the half hour. Longer hours during the weekends. They also have one trip to the grocery in the morning. No need for a car here. We had plentiful and quick access to Uber and Lyft if we needed it and was much cheaper than taxi. Just an FYI the taxi ride from the airport was about $50 including tip but the Uber back was only $30 to give you an idea. You could walk to the Rio across the parking lot if you so desired. Great views of the Rio, the Palms, the strip and the mountains. I would definitely go back in a heartbeat. The beds were super comfy every night to fall asleep and rest up for the next days adventures.

reviews.title: Wonderful property and great staff!
reviews.text: We did not know that our Wyndham housekeeping credits were not valid for our five night stay so we were charged $107The property itself is beautiful and the staff was outstanding

reviews.title: Vegas fun
reviews.text: We were very happy with our stay at Desert Blue.  The shuttle service was great, and the Valet service was excellent.  Our room was clean and very comfortable. It was nice not being on the strip but very close by.  We would highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: Desert Blue
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort in great location and has 2 good-size pool and jacuzzi. Room is clean and good size.

reviews.title: 2nd Stay - always happy with Desert Blue
reviews.text: Love the Desert Blue. It is the second time we stayed. The Desert Blue has large rooms, lovely pool with bar and grill and convenient shuttle to strip. No need to rent a car.

reviews.title: Don’t do it !!! Esp if you have children
reviews.text: I recently stayed at this resort, hoping for a tranquil escape from the city. However, the experience fell short of expectations. The room was dingy, emitting a persistent dank smell, and clearly hadn't been updated in years. Despite the high price tag, amenities like coffee at the snack bar were exorbitantly priced. Additionally, the resort fees were unreasonable. Throughout the night, loud music blared from a neighboring room until the early hours, despite my attempts to address the issue with unhelpful staff. While security was present, their effectiveness was questionable, as evidenced by the oversight of the disruptive noise. Furthermore, the presence of a disturbing pedo symbol by the pool cast a shadow of unease over our stay, prompting us to cut our trip short due to feeling unsafe. Overall, this resort failed to provide the peaceful retreat advertised, leaving us disappointed and uncomfortable.

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: This resort is well maintained with a lot of amenities and events throughoutthe week. I would stay again but in a bigger unit. The pool area is very nice. They have a shuttle but I did not use it because we had a car. The only thing that frustrated me was there is no house keeping but you can request towels and they knock on doors at 7:30 am day of your checkout to wake people up.

reviews.title: Off Strip Vegas living
reviews.text: Nice clean off strip accommodation that's close enough to see all the bright lights but far enough from the hustle-and-bustle so you can get a good night sleep and enjoy the comforts of heating up leftovers in the fully stocked kitchenette. I'm glad to hear they plan to extend their pool and poolside cafe hours.

reviews.title: Loved the Spa Tub
reviews.text: Great view. Wonderful bed in one bedroom unit.  Sofa couch mattress very thin tho.  Kitchen had everything you would need and full frig.  Dishwasher rack was damaged but desk didn't know about that.  We didn't run it. We enjoyed the deep tub in the Bedroom with its jets.  Very relaxing and nice perk.

reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text: I just want to say that this was my first Wyndham hotel experience and it was a great time. I said for a complete week and this was by far a grand experience. The hotel was very clean and decorated nicely. The staff was pleasant and helpful. This hotel is a gem of Los Vegas and Should not be passed up. Thanks for the service you give keep doing an amazing job.

reviews.title: Best stay ever
reviews.text: Excellent attention, fast and comfortable service, they offer free trips to the centre of the strip round trip, 10/10 hygiene, 10/10 kindness, they help you with your doubts or concerns and even with tourist places

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL ROOMS/HORRIBLE SALE PITCH
reviews.text: We were in Vegas for a concert and enjoyed the fact that the facilty did not have a casino. It was nice to be off the strip. The facility has a shuittle that will take you to/from the strip which is a PLUS along with a daily trip to the grocery store. One downfall, you were POLICED bringing drinks to the pool as they wanted you to buy the HIGH PRICED drinks at the bar. The rooms were awesome! Felt like apartments and very spacious.THAN CAME THE PRESSURE SALES - We agreed to do the 90-min sales meeting, it was HOT and was before we had plans, that meeting went 3 hours! We couldn't get out! They had taken our DL and based on on address had already pulled an income idea and were SO PUSHY. We just wanted to be on vacation! We would be willing to stay at the property again - if NO REQUIREMENT to do the freaking sales pitch!

reviews.title: Great family place to stay
reviews.text: Travel to this resort with my wife and two kids. We all had great things to say about this resort. It was clean, staff was nice and helpful, rooms were big and spacious, beds were soft, pool and hot tub were heated, close to activities in Las Vegas, great view from the room, Valet was fast to bring your car. Overall too big thumbs up! We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: A nice place to stay while in LV
reviews.text: Close to Chinatown and the Strip.  A nice quiet location but close to many hotels, casinos and the Fashion Show mall and many Asian restaurants in the China Town area. Right off the I-15. The rooms have a full size kitchen and refrigerator which is great for eating in instead of dining out for every meal.  There is also a restaurant on the premises but we have never tried it.

reviews.title: Exquisite Experience
reviews.text: Club Wyndham Desert Blue was an exquisite experience for me in Las Vegas. I was blessed with a 2 bedroom suite thru my affiliation with RCI for a week long stay! I couldn’t have been more satisfied.It was very spacious, immaculate. Not a spec of dust anywhere! Tall ceilings, expansive floor plan, beautiful decor & modern furnishings. It was my very own apartment that I lived in for a week! The full kitchen to include an oven was fully stocked with everything you could possibly need! The tv had all my favorite channels. The bedding was plush & inviting. My very favorite feature was the jacuzzi tub that I indulged in every night to soothe my aches & pains! My suite on the 12th floor had a panoramic view of the Strip. And they made it easy for us to get to the Strip with their free hourly shuttle (but be kind & tip the driver)! The common areas were so beautiful with very modern decor like I love! They had up a beautiful Christmas tree & the first night I checked in they were serving holiday drinks & treats! The staff was so kind. They left me alone to do me & that’s all I wanted. The pool area is beautiful with private cabanas & an eatery where you can purchase hot food. Oh, the shuttle also does a daily grocery store run. And they also have a nice on-site market. The activity rooms & gym is very nice! I even practiced my pool shooting skills! All in all, everything was truly splendid & I’m putting Club Wyndham Desert Blue on my favorites list!

reviews.title: Family friendly near to strip
reviews.text: Affordable and clean hotel near the vegas strip. However housekeeping must be requested else you have to take out your own trash. Chute and bins available on every floor.Hotel offers complimentary coffee on one of the mornings. Otherwise there is a shop at the lobby that offers Starbucks vending machine, and other fridge drinks, snacks and essentials.There is shuttle to treasure Island. Very convenient. Friendly valet parking.There was letter to santa activity and hotel replied to the letters the children wrote with a personalised response and candy cane. Very nice gesture.Good recommendation if you rented a car and do not wish to pay extra staying on the strip but yet near enough to the key attractions.

reviews.title: Clean, secure and organized
reviews.text: Close proximity to the Las Vegas strip, restaurants, resorts and casinos. Great gated security patrolled  parking for oversized trucks, RV,s and autos. Highly recommend and will definitely return and or use again.

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: Front desk and member services staff were all very friendly and helpful. Resort is beautifully maintained and the room was killer. They have a convenient shuttle to and from the strip every hour during the day.

reviews.title: amazing resort
reviews.text: Definitely will go back they cater to your needs , well maintained organized , shuttle bus leaves every hour to the strip .They have this amazing pool with lounge chaise in the water, rooms are clean the whole property is amazing

reviews.title: Somewhat Disappointing Wyndham Resort
reviews.text: We had planned our stay here with family who are owners and based our events around use of the shuttle they provide to get to the strip. We arrived on a Saturday and on Sunday evening the city closed the street in front of the resort which is the main entrance to the property. The shuttle was no longer offered!  Several Ubers canceled as they could not figure out how to get in to get us. When we addressed concerns and questions to the management we were told they had no idea they were closing the street… really? We noticed that the formula 1 construction was scattered around the town but other properties seemed to have signs for drivers to know how to access their resorts. Also, we learned there is a website that updates the construction project. Bad planning (rather, no planning) on their part and we spent much more time and $ on getting around. Their way of handling this left such a bad taste we will not go back to this resort.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet, great location.
reviews.text: The 2 bedroom unit was perfect for a group. There were plenty of dishes, silverware etc.  place was clean and nicely decorated.  Transportation provided to the strip.  Pool area was lovely.  Bar available.

reviews.title: Large Rooms & Nice New Building
reviews.text: The room was larger than most studios I have stayed in.  The furniture and amenities were all in great condition.  The pool area had plenty of spots to sit and the pool bar/grill was convenient and staffed with friendly people.

reviews.title: Non responsive
reviews.text: Booked here for my first ever trip to the US on a non-refundable booking through booking.com. I made the booking just before going to bed and in the morning awoke to find that the hotel had messaged me to tell me that my choice of bed may not be available. So I thought I’d cancel and go somewhere else. For the past two weeks I have called, emailed through booking.com and even emailed the hotel itself to request a waive of the non-refundable cancellation fee, due to 1. Them potentially not honouring my choice of bed 2. The time between booking and cancelling (merely hours) 3. The fact that the booking wasn’t until the of November, almost two months away from when I booked it.The fact that they won’t even respond shows exactly how they view customers and gives you a very good idea about their customer service. I am currently pursuing MY money back through my bank and lawyer as their non response is a breach of consumer rights and could be considered fraud. Will let you all know how that goes.

reviews.title: Wyndham desert blue
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the stay here . It was off the strip and has no smoking or casino gambling which in my opinion was a great bonus from the hustle and bustle of the strip. Everthing was very close driving distance Ceasers Palace was about 5 minutes New Orleans was down the street and Rio is right across the street.  Just a heads up not walking distance from any restaurants.

reviews.title: Good stay.
reviews.text: We stayed here in September for our 10-year wedding anniversary and it was ok. It was nice to stay away from the strip, park our rental car and take the shuttle when we wanted to go to town. The room was spacious and comfortable. The pool area was awesome and we enjoyed the hot tub after a day exploring. I do have to mention that the fridge in our unit was so noisy that it  kept us up the first night. When I went to unplug it, because the noise was unbearable, I noticed that it probably hadn't been moved in ages! There was a lot of debris under there... Pretty gross... Overall, the room was clean and comfortable but that did make us feel a little uneasy. We reported this to the front desk the next day and they sent a nice chap from the maintenance team up to replace it when we were checking-out. He was also nice enough to clean the area underneath the appliance for us and was very apologetic. Decent hotel and convenient stay.

reviews.title: Very comfortable week
reviews.text: We had a two bedroom unit on the ninth floor and were very happy with it. Comfortable furniture, including beds, open floor plan and two full baths contributed to our comfort.  The pool area was beautiful. Our view of the strip was beautiful day and night.  We were less than a 10 minutes drive away from the strip and the hourly shuttle provided was very convenient, day and night.  Overall, we would happily go back!

reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Blue for one week and had a lovely time.  The room was a good size with a comfortable king size bed, and very quiet so we were never disturbed during the night.  The pool area was beautiful with plenty of sun loungers and a snack bar.  Although we were asked if we would like to attend a timeshare presentation our decline was respectively received as we are happy with our own resort.  We were disappointed that our room/bedding had not beem cleaned during our stay and it was explained that this was due to it being a timeshare hotel but we could pay extra if we wished, our own timeshare do clean the rooms half way through a weeks stay so this was unusual for us, but you could request clean towels etc.  The shuttle was very much appreciated, there were always plenty of seats available and always on time, setting off from the hotel hourly and returning from the Treasure Island pick up.  If we were to return we would choose this hotel again.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, pushy and aggressive staff
reviews.text: Clean and nice hotel and a great pool. The shuttle to the strip is great and the free car parking is a nice bonus.  Very pushy staff with the time share presentation. I felt I was unable to say no to attending and when I declined attending I was not allowed to say no. It is manipulative to send guests to member services for their check in bracelet and forcing a sales pitch. We paid good money for our trip and our time is worth money and should be enjoyed, very aggressive and rude to do this to guests. I was charged $40 on my credit card. I dont recommend this hotel because of this. I would like a refund for my deposit and to speak with the manager.

reviews.title: Better Than I Expected
reviews.text: It was a great stay with my mother and sisters.  We had 3 rooms all were very clean, the pool area is beautiful. The staff were great, and the best part was the wristbands for all access instead of keeping up with a key card.  Location was perfect!  No hustle bustle from the strip.  Easy access everywhere.

reviews.title: Restful and comfortable retreat
reviews.text: nice rooms, comfortable bed, kitchen, nice bathroom.  A nice alternative to smoky casinos.  This place has great pools and very comfortable.  Close to the strip if you must go!!! nice coffee shop for breakfast within walking distance.

reviews.title: Good infrastructure, with the comfort of a home
reviews.text: Located less than 5 minutes by car from the Strip, in a quiet and easily accessible location. We stayed in a very spacious presidential unit with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, with a living room, dining room and equipped kitchen, on a high floor, with a beautiful view of the Strip buildings. Super comfortable beds, clean and well-maintained facilities. Wifi with good connection.Free self-service parking, with plenty of space. Good pool, games room, gym, convenient business center.Very quick check-in and check-out, very attentive service.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: My stay at the desert blue is great.Location and facilities are excellent.Good for families with kids.We don't have to exposed our kids to the gambling table and slots machines.The pool and games available in the club can help to occupied kids free time.

reviews.title: Theft!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here from 6/22-6/25. On Sunday 6/24 my family and I got the shuttle at 11am to meet the rest of our family, that was staying at another location. During this time, we all went to eat, and rented a party bus. I left back to the hotel and arrived at 6:30 pm by myself, as the rest of my family were still going to gamble and go to clubs. Once my daughter and son arrived back at 4:30am, my son noticed $2,000 dollars missing from his backpack. I felt bad, because I was the only one in the room, other than going to the pool from 7:30pm till 8:45. We searched the room, NOTHING, money was gone. We went down to the front to let them know, what had happened. 2 security ran reports to see if anyone had accessed our room during the time we were gone. Guess what! There was an entrance into our room at 4:27pm. We were all on the party bus at that time and I have videos and pictures of all of us. Next access into our room was at 6:39 when I had arrived back myself. They advised us, they do not have cameras in the hallways. Why can’t they pull up camera footage from the elevators at the time our room was accessed to see who went in that direction? We were also advised that it was our key that opened the door, HOW the keys were in the drawers. We wore our wristbands. So, now we are in the process of working with LV Metro. This is scary, knowing someone was in our room, especially knowing I was by myself. Please watch your surroundings and stay safe and take valuables with you. I will never stay here again. Management dismissed us and did not even come out to speak with us. It was the 2 security guards that helped us and let us know what they had found. Not only are we out $2,000, we were treated as if we were making this up, when I have proof and they can look at camera footage that we were not on the property at that time and someone accessed our room at 4:27pm!

reviews.title: Extra unexpected charges
reviews.text: This property is nothing but a ripoff.  They charged us $108 for HOUSEKEEPING after we left which was not part of our room charge.  They claim it’s because we are RCI members.  WE ARE NOT and never have been.   This is just wrong.  Do not stay here.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Desert Blue resort is a 20 minute walk to the strip but there is an hourly shuttle to get you to the Treasure Island resort which is on the strip.  10am each morning the shuttle goes to the grocery store so that you can stock up on food that you can prepare in your unit.  We didn't do much other than attend some shows and laze by the pool but being off the strip means it is a bit quieter, hence more relaxing.

reviews.title: Excellent hospitality
reviews.text: BEST IN THE WEST Great staff, pool front desk bars ,ground keeper, timeshare desks. clean rooms, hallways , common areas, fast internent, beds werecomfortable, spa worked great . Shuttle service to strip. Smoke free.

reviews.title: Modern and clean
reviews.text: Great location with a short walk to the strip. Our two bedroom unit was spacious. We were on the ninth floor with really great views.  Clean unit with modern decor.  We traveled as a family with an eight year old and a 17-year-old and they were spacious. Also, the living room had a sofa bed pull out.

reviews.title: Margaritaville in Vegas
reviews.text: Great location with direct to the strip shuttle. Choice of standard or Margaritaville themed rooms. Pools with tiki style cafe & bar. Views of the strip. Access to freeways. Concierge staff to help plan your shows and atrractions

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed for 4 nights whilst at a convention.  It is a very good option for anyone wanting to avoid having to walk through a casino.  The location and facilities are also very good.  The only bad part was the timeshare selling.  We said at the outset there was 0% chance of buying a timeshare, but still they talk and talk to try and get you to go to (in our case) a time wasting presentation.  At the end I wish I had just been rude and walked away rather than be polite with staff who are not listening.  I won't make the same mistake if we return.

reviews.title: 7 day 6 night stay
reviews.text: My husband and I visited Las Vegas, Nevada for the first time. It was wonderful. We stayed at Wyndham Dessert Blue, which was a remarkable experience. The stay was great from beginning to our last night.  The entire staff was always hospitable and kind.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Love it, even though there was construction going on during our stay, some parts of the hotel where closed.  The dinning options where very limited within the hotel.  There is NO restaurant for breakfast near.

reviews.title: Accommodating staff, spacious rooms and convenient location
reviews.text: I’ve returned to this location several times. No resort fees and great staff make this a gem. The front desk manager Kyce is super accommodating. Pool staff made us a tasty breakfast burrito and super friendly. Heated pool at this time of year is a draw. Will definitely return.

reviews.title: Had a great experience
reviews.text: This was my first time to Vegas and just know it won’t be my last. From the dissent to the party bus, to the clubs and casino, comedy show and sights, I enjoyed my vacation. Tip: It’s cold there in January so pick somewhere you can swim indoors.

reviews.title: Perfect spot for peace and quiet away from, but close to strip
reviews.text: Check in was a breeze. The room (studio) was huge and clean and quiet. It was a 10 dollar uber to about anywhere or jump on the free shuttle to caesars. Wasn't hassled about timeshares. I will come back here next time for sure

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Very clean, nice rooms. Helpful staff. It does not have a restaurant/ cafe on site, only snacks that were a bit pricey. Room are equipped with refrigerator & stove/ microwave. They held fun activities, top of the line customer service!

reviews.title: Great views just off the strip!
reviews.text: We’ve stayed at many Wyndham’s and this is a great one. I prefer it over the Grand Desert. Off the strip, but nice to get away from the smoke and crowds! Also, the valet service is great and fast! Highly recommend a stay here when coming to Vegas.

reviews.title: Very Good off-strip Accommodation
reviews.text: Very good place to stay in Las Vegas. While located off of the strip area, there is a free hourly shuttle to Ceasers Palace and return. The 10am  shuttle takes you to a grocery store so you can pick up nessary supplies. Our 3 bedroom unit (1535) had great views of the various hotels along the strip area. A small convenience shop onsite had essentials such as water, wine, beer, snacks, etc

reviews.title: Misleading. Downgrading rooms with false equivalence and dishonest customer service.
reviews.text: We purchased a stay for 5 days in one of their villas on AirBnB, and when we arrived, were given a small studio that did not include some of the amenities listed in the ad. Customer service downplayed our complaint and said it was the “same” and was a standard room. We were later tricked into getting wrist bands to replace our room keys the next day, which turned out to be a sales pitch to go on a “Tour” for 1.5 hours. After we neglectfully accepted their offer to sit through a 1.5 hr tour, we were told we had to make a non refundable $40 down payment in the event we didn’t show. They offered a $125 American Express as a reward. We assume they were going to try to talk us into buying something in the likes of a time share. The salesman also spilled the beans that he heard a lot of people got downgraded this weekend. The room was nice, but due to having purchased it through Airbnb there was no room service or cleaning. There were some hairs and a zit bandaid stuck to the bathroom floor upon arrival. The stay was decent but we felt disgusted by the sales pitch and the downgrade during our stay. We were offered no compensation or concessions for our downgrade and were scared to bring it back up after they shrugged us off when we addressed it to the front desk. They did say that the Airbnb host was at fault for this bs, but I decided that I would also leave a review for the resort because the nature of their relationship with the host allows this type of misleading advertising and service.
